prompt: Read fixed trace/statistics. Minimize completion_cycles using up to 20 backend calls including identity and reverse. Submit legal swap_bits DSL with a brief testable hypothesis and prediction; use feedback to decide the next proposal. No trace/config changes, no oracle or competitor results during search. One-shot: freeze 18 candidates before any task performance is revealed; no subsequent revision.
information: All methods have the same raw trace, config and statistics. Adaptive methods receive their own metrics. One-shot intentionally receives no performance feedback. Heuristic functions are the same available tools; backend calls are counted per run.
cost_boundary: Every unique actual backend execution counts, including failures. Cache hits and invalid proposals do not; proposal cap=200. Oracle calls are separate, after search. Feature extraction/verification/file I/O/model thinking are not backend time.
limits: Agent both designed and ran tasks: not blind or preregistered external evaluation
one conversation run per task; same model also generated one-shot batch
one-shot commitment precedes all performance; prior task design/old experiments known
six-bit synthetic toy; no real HBM or LLM serving performance claim
no full XOR-space optimum; no held-out generalization assessment
model token count, runtime identifier, fees and isolated inference time unavailable
